rule: walk: key K from each entry's tag 29 (kind, flow_id, env, version), tag 27 stream_id and tenant; every entry of a chain has the same K and chain.seq = its index; entry 0 has prev_checksum = genesis(K), entry i>0 the previous checksum; checksum = SHA-256(prev_checksum || digest); a DECISION_SEALED digest recomputes as record digest v4; an AUDIT_ENTRY digest is an OPAQUE stand-in (SHA-256 of "chain-link-vector:<entry_id>", not the store's per-kind entry digest) and is only linked, never recomputed. JSON and pb decode to the same event.
